readerReview: Canonical opening, chapter map, conclusion, methodological limits and selected substantive passages supporting the script. Does not certify every sentence or reference in the book.

figures.decision: Inspected; not directly embedded. Cover and dense static source figures are reserved for reading; original conceptual staging preserves the relevant relation without presenting model values as measurements.

artMeaning: The book’s hearth metaphor becomes a colorful communal workroom: contribution sustains capacity, divided custody limits power, and a member can take knowledge into a separate effort.
